children: ) today released Week 4 of its Better 2.0 weekly scorecard, a public record of the company’s turnaround published every Tuesday. This week, Better’s AI-powered HELOC went live with one of our largest partners, giving a large group of American homeowners a faster, simpler way to tap their home equity ahead of the holidays, whether to fund home improvements, consolidate debt, buy a new home, pay tuition or take a holiday vacation. Better also continued to execute on its cost reduction plan, increasing total realized savings to $30.4 million, well on its path towards its $64.2 million target.

Since the Week 3 scorecard published on October 27, Better has realized additional efficiencies in its corporate organization by de-layering management roles and executing additional high value expert labor tasks through enhanced use of AI agents, expected to generate $5.9 million in annualized savings, exceeding the $1.7 million goal set last week. The company has also capped vendor spend, expected to generate $1.6 million in annualized savings.

This week’s actions add $7.5 million to the $22.9 million completed in the first two weeks, bringing completed actions to $30.4 million in annualized savings as the Company works toward a target of approximately $64.2 million once all initiatives are fully implemented.

“American homeowners are sitting on over $21.4 trillion in home equity, while still paying 12% to 36% APR on credit cards and personal loans. With our partnership launch this week, tens of millions more homeowners can see what their home equity could unlock and apply for a HELOC right where they already manage their money, powered by Better. This is the growth Better 2.0 is built for: integrated platform offerings, with no upfront customer acquisition cost, and massive revenue lift for both Better and its partners,” said Vishal Garg, Founder and Head of Product, Platform and Innovation at Better. “Furthermore, four weeks in, we’re at $30.4 million in savings, and you’ll continue to receive updates every Tuesday, until we hit breakeven.”
Actioned efficiencies in mortgage operations expected to deliver $5.9M in annualized savings
Capped vendor spend, expected to deliver $1.6M in annualized savings
Additional savings opportunities identified, expected to deliver $1.5M annualized
Launched Better’s AI-powered HELOC with a large existing partner

Signed an exclusive, long-term partnership with a large rental credit management platform in the US, which serves more than 1.2 million consumers, to instantly prequalify prospective homebuyers for a Better Mortgage

Signed an exclusive, long-term partnership with the largest home inspection company in the US, giving consumers instant access to HELOCs, the Home Card and cash-out refinancing to finance home repairs and improvements more affordably
Additional mortgage brokerages in the pipeline being onboarded onto the wholesale platform
Making progress with 3 other major partners and one new revived large-scale partnership

Received five term sheets from prospective financing partners for approximately $50 million of debt financing related to the planned sale of Birmingham Bank, Better’s UK bank subsidiary, which can be used to bolster the stock buyback and additional growth initiatives

Evaluate bridge financing proposals and continue to advance the planned sale of Birmingham Bank. Opportunistically evaluate and execute potential additional debt financing secured by the Bank stake to enable additional share repurchases and bolster balance sheet.
Better will continue to publish its management scorecard weekly until it achieves Adjusted EBITDA breakeven, reporting completed actions, outstanding commitments and changes to timelines.

) is the first AI-native mortgage and home equity finance platform, and first fintech to fund more than $110 billion in loan volume. Since 2016, Better has leveraged its industry-leading AI platform, Tinman®, to achieve a singular mission of making homeownership cheaper, faster, and easier for all Americans. Tinman® allows customers to see their rate options in seconds, get pre-approved in minutes, lock in rates, and close their loan in as little as three weeks. In addition, Betsy®, leveraging Tinman® MCP, the first AI loan agent built exclusively for the mortgage industry, is revolutionizing the homebuying journey by delivering timely application status updates to consumers, answering questions, and moving their loan application along 24/7/365. Better’s mortgage offerings include GSE-conforming, FHA, VA loans, jumbo, and Non-QM mortgage loans as well as home equity loans. Better serves customers in all 50 US states.
